name: The Perfect Dress
source:
A small kinetic novel about a student girl who is looking for a dress for her ball.
But the salesman is instantly captivated by Ellie’s natural beauty and will try to manipulate her.

[From [url=https://lounatick.itch.io/the-perfect-dress]itch.io[/url]]
